summary: The Nemotron margin chart is a clear core visual, but the slogan headline, kicker, pipeline cards, Qwen stat panel and repeated footer add clutter; the graphic is complete and names the benchmark and metrics.
defects: Logo (e1) is near-invisible: pale strokes on cream background
Subtitle wraps with a single orphan word, 'GDPval.'
